a.lede: Nvidia’s board unanimously reinstated Huang 11 days after his removal, but his troubles may not be over.
a.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang is back after a stunning reversal

b.lede: Jensen Huang returned to the office after being reinstated to CEO to cheers, according to videos spread on social media.
b.title: Jensen Huang returns to applause from employees at Nvidia HQ
